description: Invite a person to the organization as an admin or member. The invitee receives an email and creates their own account; no credential is returned. Share only the mailboxes they need with mailbox_ids; "all" is allowed only when the person behind this credential reads every mailbox and the credential is not restricted. Needs the members:write permission, which is opt-in and never part of a default. It acts with the authority of the person who approved this connection or created the API key.

email.description: Address to invite. The person creates their own account.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

mailbox_access.description: `selected` (the default) shares only mailbox_ids. `all` shares every mailbox, now and later.

mailbox_ids.description: Mailboxes to share for "selected" access. Ignored for "all".

newsletter_role.description: Set to editor to let a member edit newsletters. Only for the member role.

name: shipmail_invite_member

mailbox_ids.description: Mailbox IDs visible to this API credential. Empty when scope is "all"; for "selected", the list can be partial when the credential reaches only some granted mailboxes.

newsletter_role.description: "editor" lets the invitee edit newsletters. Only a member can carry it.

title: Invite Member
